title: The Curse of Monkey Island
japaneseTitle: カース・オブ・モンキー・アイランド
shortDescription: LucasArts' gorgeous hand-drawn cartoon adventure, marking Guybrush Threepwood's full voice-acted pirate debut.
historicalSignificance: The pinnacle of the classic LucasArts SCUMM graphic adventure era, celebrated for its cel-animated hand-painted Disney-quality art style, brilliant rhyming pirate sea-shanties, and Dominic Armato's career-defining voice performance.

editorialContent.overview: When mighty pirate Guybrush Threepwood unwittingly gives his beloved Elaine Marley a cursed diamond ring that turns her into a solid gold statue, he must sail across Plunder Island and Blood Island to lift the curse and defeat the demon pirate LeChuck.
editorialContent.gameplay: Refined point-and-click verb coin interface, featuring witty inventory puzzles, the hilarious rhyming insult swordplay mechanics on the high seas, and dual difficulty settings ('Normal' and 'Mega-Monkey').
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: The twelfth and final game built on the legendary SCUMM engine, featuring hand-painted SVGA 640x480 resolution animated backgrounds and Michael Land's live-instrument iMUSE interactive music system.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Considered by adventure game purists as one of the finest comedy games ever written, introducing the definitive vocal cast for Guybrush, Elaine, and LeChuck.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Preserved on two original CD-ROM discs and remastered for modern operating systems via ScummVM.

verifiedFactualData.sales: Over 500,000 units sold in North America and Europe
awards: Computer Gaming World Adventure Game of the Year 1997

technicalSpecs.engine: SCUMM (Script Creation Utility for Maniac Mansion) v8
technicalSpecs.soundChip: iMUSE dynamic interactive MIDI/PCM music engine
